blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — There is a strong indication that gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang, who is implicated in the case of the missing “sabungeros” (cockfighting enthusiasts), is still in the country, according to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI). NBI Director Melvin Matibag said this in an interview on Tuesday shortly after the Department of Justice (DOJ) confirmed that the Manila Regional Trial Court has issued an arrest warrant against Ang, along with his co-accused former police officer Ryan Jay Orapa. The arrest warrant is in addition to the arrest orders the Laguna and Batangas courts issued in January. READ: Manila […]... Keep on reading: NBI: There’s a strong indication Atong Ang still in PH
